title: aopLinkageSummary producer STRICT emission contract
description: The additionalProperties:false emission contract for the SERVER-AUTHORED aopLinkageSummary block, reconstructed by RUNNING the real InteropResource._build_aop_linkage_summary producer (both the standalone build_aop_linkage_summary response root AND the embedded assemble_comptox_evidence_pack `aopLinkageSummary` sub-block — they share the same core builder). The LOAD-BEARING strict surface is the SERVER-AUTHORED `confidence` conclusion block (score / band / basis — the qualitative confidence judgment the server invents ON TOP of relayed CompTox crosswalk rows) and each `mappings[]` entry (whose `evidenceDirection` is the per-linkage direction assertion): a field outside the declared set on `confidence` or a mapping entry is a SOURCE_CONTRACT_VIOLATION that BLOCKS BEFORE projection, closing the producer-emission-contract dead-arm class. The block ROOT is additionalProperties:true ON PURPOSE: the standalone response (annotated by _annotate_public_payload) carries extra envelope fields (provenanceSummary / limitations / knownDataGaps / generatedFromTools / identityResolution) that the embedded copy does not, and the projection never reads a free key off the root; over-tightening the root would falsely reject one of the two faithful emissions (the over-tighten lesson). The relayed bags (chemicalRef, supportingAssays items, provenance) spread upstream EPA CompTox / ccte identity + crosswalk fields verbatim and are additionalProperties:true ON PURPOSE.
